SGS_MOD_V3_EVENT_PU_YUAN_ANCIENT.pages.I:
The forge glows red. The smith quenches a blade; white steam rises, and he looks up at his visitor.
"Arms are ill omens, yet a world in chaos cannot do without them. Choose one that fits your hand."

SGS_MOD_V3_EVENT_PU_YUAN_ANCIENT.pages.D:
"Mechanisms blend with wondrous arts; armor and arms for heroes."
Pu Yuan says no more. He turns back to the anvil, and the hammering fades.

SGS_MOD_V3_EVENT_PU_YUAN_ANCIENT.talk.SG: I have forged weapons all my life. When will I see swords beaten into plowshares?
